issues.jp_before: 雨[あめ]がひどいので、犬[いぬ]を家[いえ]に{入[い]れました|tr-hairu}。
issues.problem: Present ひどいので clashes with the past narrative ('It was raining hard').
issues.action: Changed to ひどかったので.

issues.jp_before: 郵便局[ゆうびんきょく]へ手紙[てがみ]を{出[だ]しに行[い]きます|tr-hairu}。
issues.problem: Distractor 出しに来ます tested 行く/来る rather than the transitive pair; why referred to that.
issues.action: Replaced distractors with 出させに行きます / 出られに行きます alongside 出に行きます; why rewritten.

issues.jp_before: 階段[かいだん]を{上[あ]がって|tr-hairu}、右[みぎ]にトイレがあります。
issues.problem: Te-form followed by an existence statement is awkward for directions.
issues.action: Rewrote as 階段を上がると、右にトイレがあります with matching English and dictionary-form distractors.

issues.jp_before: お皿[さら]を{下[さ]げてもいいですか|tr-hairu}。
issues.problem: why mentions a waiter who is not in the sentence.
issues.action: why now says the speaker clears the plates.

issues.jp_before: この店[みせ]は先月[せんげつ]、値段[ねだん]を{下[さ]げました|tr-hairu}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 店は商品の値段を上げました item (shop changes prices).
issues.action: Rewrote as テレビの音量を少し下げてもらえますか。

issues.jp_before: 気温[きおん]が{下[さ]がる|tr-hairu}と、湖[みずうみ]に氷[こおり]が張[は]ります。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 夜は気温が下がります (third temperature item).
issues.action: Rewrote as 値段が下がるまで、買うのを待ちます。

issues.jp_before: 机[つくえ]から消[け]しゴムが{落[お]ちて|tr-hairu}いますよ。
issues.problem: 机から落ちています is an unnatural way to describe something lying where it fell.
issues.action: Rewrote as 机の下に消しゴムが落ちていますよ (There's an eraser lying under the desk).

issues.jp_before: 試験[しけん]に{落[お]ちて|tr-hairu}、とても悲[かな]しかったです。
issues.problem: Distractor 落とされて (passive, 'was failed') is close to acceptable with the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced with potential 落とせて, which is ungrammatical here.

issues.jp_before: 風[かぜ]で帽子[ぼうし]が川[かわ]に{落[お]ちました|tr-hairu}。
issues.problem: Distractor 落とされました (passive) is marginally acceptable with the wind as cause and the same English meaning; why was vague.
issues.action: Replaced with 落としていました; why rewritten.
